title: The sheaf Hom between coherent modules is coherent
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme and $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Then the sheaf Hom $\mathcal H=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ [def-pur-sheaf-hom] (taken on the site of open subsets of $X$: $\mathcal H(U)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_U}(\mathcal G|_U,\mathcal F|_U)$) is a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module. (Stacks proves more: for any ringed space, $\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)$ is locally the kernel of a map between finite direct sums of copies of $\mathcal F$ when $\mathcal G$ is of finite presentation, and is coherent when moreover $\mathcal F$ is coherent; a coherent $\mathcal G$ is of finite presentation, being of finite type with finite type kernels of all local maps $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}\to\mathcal G|_U$.)

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CQ (lemma-internal-hom-locally-kernel-direct-sum, line 3739), 'in particular' clause; its proof cites the proof of Lemma 01CP (lemma-stalk-internal-hom) and Lemma 01BY (lemma-coherent-abelian); used in Cohomology of Schemes, proof of Lemma 0883 (lemma-fully-faithful)

proof.text: For each $x\in X$, obtain an open neighbourhood $U_x$ and a kernel model $\mathcal Hom(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)|_{U_x}\cong\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_x)$ between finite biproducts of $\mathcal F|_{U_x}$ by [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-hom-local-kernel]. The opens cover $X$ since $x\in U_x$.

Restrict coherence of $\mathcal F$ to each $U_x$ using [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover](1). Both finite biproducts in the kernel model are coherent by the finite-sum clause of [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-modules-kernel-cokernel-sum]. Its kernel is coherent by the kernel clause, and isomorphism invariance transports this to the restricted Hom. These clauses include ranks zero.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-module-local-on-open-cover](2) to the covering $(U_x)_{x\in X}$ and the coherent restricted Hom modules from step 2. This proves coherence of the original Hom module. For the empty scheme the point-indexed cover is empty and still has supremum top.
